reviews.text: Cj’s is the best. Our 3 dogs jump out of the car when we get there & get so excited when they realize where we are going. It’s such a peace of mind knowing our furbabies are so well loved  & taken care of when we are out of town. Thank you to the whole staff who always go above and beyond for our babies.

Absolutely the best!! The staff is very understanding and accommodating!! We are so grateful to have our dog go there! He gets so excited for daycare and overnight stay. We took our dog there before he got neutered and we were so nervous but Christy answered all our questions and made us feel comfortable. It has been the best decision! Reasonably priced and drop off/pick up service is great!

Our dog Olive has been going to CJ Staycation  for a full year now, and I can honestly say it has been nothing short of amazing. From the very first visit, Christy and her incredible staff made Olive feel loved, safe, and right at home.

Christy’s dedication to what she does shines through in every interaction. She isn’t just running a business—she’s creating a space filled with care, joy, and genuine affection for the dogs (and their humans!) who come through her doors. Every drop-off is met with happy greetings, tail wags, and the peace of mind that Olive will be well cared for. Every pick-up comes with stories of her day, her new doggie friends, and her adventures—leaving us with happy hearts.

The staff’s attentiveness, kindness, and professionalism are unmatched. They treat Olive like she’s part of their family, which means the world to ours. It’s rare to find a place that blends top-notch service with such personal warmth, but Christy has created exactly that.

Thank you, Christy, for bringing so much joy to Olive’s life and ours. We are beyond grateful for you and your wonderful team—you’ve truly made CJ Staycation a second home for our girl.

— Leslie L.
Gatsby has fun- he knows Christie and once he relaxes- he looks like he enjoys it!!
